<noinclude>
This template lets an editor set this page's own SEO title, meta description,
and/or mark it as a placeholder that shouldn't be indexed yet, without writing
any HTML or raw parser-function syntax.

'''Usage''' (all parameters optional, use only what you need):

<pre>
{{SEO
 |title       = Custom search-result/browser-tab title
 |description = Custom meta description (aim for roughly 150-160 characters)
 |noindex     = yes
}}
</pre>

Place it near the top of the article, above or below {{tl|Article status}}.

If you're marking a page as a placeholder, {{tl|Article status}} itself now
also accepts a <code>noindex=yes</code> parameter directly, which is usually
more convenient than adding a separate {{SEO}} call just for that one thing.

When no {{SEO|title=}}/{{SEO|description=}} is given, EDFM generates a
plain mechanical fallback automatically (page name + site name; "X reference
for Elite Dangerous commanders...") -- set them explicitly only when a more
specific, human-written title or description would genuinely help search
results or social shares. Most pages don't need this template at all.

See [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Editorial Policy]] for EDFM's general
content standards.
</noinclude><includeonly>{{#seo:{{#if:{{{title|}}}|title={{{title}}}|}}|{{#if:{{{description|}}}|description={{{description}}}|}}|{{#if:{{{noindex|}}}|noindex={{{noindex}}}|}}}}</includeonly>
